name: 10 satellites
location_str: Launch Area 96A @ Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: Ride-share of 10 satellites to sun-synchronous orbit, including LandSpace's own Guangchuan-03 & 04 for testing and demonstrating LEO communication satellite constellation technologies. Details TBD.
slot_b_text: Orbit is not about being high above Earth. It is about falling toward Earth fast enough that the ground keeps curving away.
